This method ensures that items are ranked highly only if they perform well across both retrieval systems, effectively reducing noise. Additionally, the hybrid solution improves context recall by fusing outputs from both systems, capturing both semantic details and exact entity relationships. This guarantees that the generator has access to a complete set of source facts, thereby minimizing the 'hallucination gap' that often occurs when using vector search alone, which may miss structural connections across documents.
